```yaml
name: Backend Required Quality Gates

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  backend:
    name: Backend Quality Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-ci tldw_Server_API/tests/CI

  frontend:
    name: Frontend Quality Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm test

  e2e:
    name: E2E Quality Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/e2e -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-e2e tldw_Server_API/tests/e2e

  coverage:
    name: Coverage Quality Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: pip install coverage
      - run: coverage run -m pytest tldw_Server_API/tests
      - run: coverage report --fail-under=80

  security:
    name: Security Quality Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: pip install bandit
      - run: python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bandit-report
          path: /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json
      - uses: actions/dependency-review-action@v3
```
